text:
Nina (CS): FYI HalcyonRetail just opened a request: their Pricing & Merchandising team wants to go live with real-time recommendations in ~4 weeks. they expect a substantial qps bump and a nightly embed rebuild. looking for capacity + enablement help.
Ravi (Solutions): nice. any concrete numbers yet? which model sizes are they testing?
Nina (CS): dev pilot today: steady qps ~30, peaks to 50. customer estimates post-launch steady 120 qps, peaks 180, daily tokens ~10-12M. plan is to use a 3B-ish causal model for recs, seq lens ~1500, plus nightly batch of ~2.5M docs for embeddings.
Jules (SRE): 30->120 steady is a big change. recommend: (1) separate batch pool for nightly embed runs (2) prewarm cache and increase batch sizes for realtime pool. need sample request traces and expected p95 SLOs.
Priya (Acct Exec): Renewal note: renewal in ~9 weeks. if onboarding is bumpy, they could push renewal. Finance also requested a hosted vs dedicated cost snapshot for execs. can we get a 2-line delta by Wed?
Nina (CS): I'll ask their Eng lead Mara for traces and SLOs. also they want an enablement workshop for their infra + data-engineering teams in week 1 after kickoff.
Ravi (Solutions): action items: I'll sketch a recommended config: quantized model option + fallback to a smaller 1B variant if tails spike. also advise preforked model pool for low cold-starts.
Jules (SRE): I'll run a quick perf sim once we have seq=1500 profiles. need kernel throughput numbers on the 3B opt model for seq=1500 to estimate GPU hours.
ops-bot: [ingest] HalcyonRetail intake form: projected daily token increase x4 in 30 days. tagging CS required.
Nina (CS): perfect. Mara said they may also enable conversational debugging traces (streaming) which could increase token counts further. watching that as risk.
Priya (Acct Exec): I'll schedule a 15-min sync with their CFO for Friday to set expectations; want rough cost delta options (hosted vs dedicated + burst).
Ravi (Solutions): note: separate pools + throttling policy + a canary rollout (10% traffic for 48h) is my recommended path. keeps UX safe and gives us realtime telemetry.
Jules (SRE): +1. also request that we get a sample of the nightly job manifest (memory, concurrency) so we can size the batch fleet.
Nina (CS): meeting proposed: Kickoff Thurs 10am PT (30m) with Halcyon Eng, Solutions, SRE, and AE. I'll post calendar and request traces.
Priya (Acct Exec): thanks — I'll prepare a short renewal risk brief and include the cost snapshot when Ravi/Jules have estimates. :white_check_mark: 
Ravi (Solutions): Deliverables by Wed: (1) draft config for pooling and fallbacks (2) ballpark GPU/day estimate for Dedicated pilot.
Jules (SRE): Deliverables by Wed EOD: infra sizing + cost ballpark assuming 30% cache hit and quantized model.
Nina (CS): copying action items in thread and will paste traces when Mara sends them. please keep week 2 open for enablement workshop. :calendar:
